description: Requests, failed requests and error percentage per ReplicaSet, pod and node of one Kubernetes Deployment over the last 30 minutes, from OpenTelemetry server spans. Use it to tell a bad release from a bad node: if every pod of the new ReplicaSet fails on different nodes while old pods on the same nodes are healthy, the release is the cause.

configuration.query:
FROM traces-generic.otel-default
| WHERE @timestamp > NOW() - 30 minutes
    AND k8s.namespace.name == ?namespace AND k8s.deployment.name == ?deployment
    AND kind == "Server" AND span.name != "GET /healthz"
| STATS requests = COUNT(*), errors = COUNT(*) WHERE event.outcome == "failure"
    BY k8s.replicaset.name, k8s.pod.name, k8s.node.name
| EVAL error_pct = ROUND(100.0 * errors / requests, 1)
| SORT k8s.replicaset.name, k8s.pod.name
